title: Hardware safe-mute response contract is incomplete
component_interface: Watchdog, AMP_MUTE, AMP_FAULT and PGOOD safe state
description: The product requires physical mute during off/boot/fault and fault-injection timing, but does not define electrical defaults, fault propagation or allowed response time. Software alone is disallowed.

evidence.note: Safe-state behavior is required; exact electrical/timing contract remains open.

closure_criterion: Before R4 PASS, approve the hardware default-safe, watchdog/fault/brownout mute dependency and target response-time contract from product/safety input; R2/R3 verify achievable levels and paths. Validate timing physically at EVT/EOL.
